description: This Java class 'ProductEvents' contains a collection of event handler methods related to product management within the Apache OFBiz framework. Methods include updating product keywords, managing product associations, clearing last viewed categories/products, updating shipping info, handling product features, category membership, comparison list management, and related functionalities. It leverages OFBiz entity and service APIs and integrates with web request/response objects.

classes.name: ProductEvents
classes.description: Event handler class for product-related operations in the OFBiz framework. Contains static methods for managing product keywords, associations, features, categories, shipping, and user sessions.

methods.name: updateAllKeywords
methods.description: Updates or adds keywords for all products, with permission checks and transactional safety.

methods.name: updateProductAssoc
methods.description: Updates or deletes product associations based on provided parameters and permissions.

methods.name: clearLastViewedCategories
methods.description: Clears the session attribute tracking last viewed categories.

methods.name: clearLastViewedProducts
methods.description: Clears the session attribute tracking last viewed products.

methods.name: clearAllLastViewed
methods.description: Clears all last viewed session attributes related to categories, products, and search histories.

methods.name: updateProductQuickAdminShipping
methods.description: Quick admin update of shipping-related product features such as dimensions and weight, for single or multiple products.

methods.name: setOrCreateProdFeature
methods.description: Helper method to update or create a product feature with specified units and value.

methods.name: updateProductQuickAdminSelFeat
methods.description: Updates or assigns variant/product features based on admin input, with transaction safety.

methods.name: checkUpdateFeatureApplByDescription
methods.description: Checks, updates, or creates product feature applications based on description and product variant context.

methods.name: removeFeatureApplsByFeatureTypeId
methods.description: Removes feature applications of a specific feature type from product variants and the main product.

methods.name: removeProductFeatureAppl
methods.description: Removes a specific product feature application from a product.

methods.name: addProductToCategories
methods.description: Adds a product to one or more categories with a specified effective date.

methods.name: updateProductCategoryMember
methods.description: Updates the 'thruDate' of a product's category membership.

methods.name: addProductFeatures
methods.description: Associates one or more features to a product.

methods.name: setDefaultStoreSettings
methods.description: Sets user locale, currency, and timezone defaults based on the store's configuration.

methods.name: checkStoreCustomerRole
methods.description: Verifies that a logged-in user has the customer role for the store if required.

methods.name: tellAFriend
methods.description: Sends an email to a friend with product info, using store email settings.

methods.name: getProductCompareList
methods.description: Retrieves or initializes the product comparison list stored in the session.

methods.name: addProductToComparisonList
methods.description: Adds a product to the session-based comparison list, with duplicate check.

methods.name: removeProductFromComparisonList
methods.description: Removes a specified product from the comparison list in session.

methods.name: parseBigDecimalFromParameter
methods.description: Returns a BigDecimal parsed from request parameter string, handling localization and nulls.

methods.name: addProductTags
methods.description: Adds tags to a product, parsing input string, creating keywords via service, and handling errors.
